Nothing o"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"n the plugin side can diagnose that."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Rule files"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"A rule is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Field | Meaning |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `description` | Required for the rulebook listing. |
| `alwaysApply` | Injects the whole body into"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" the system prompt. |
| `globs` | Path gate; a TTSR rule needs at least one matching candidate path."},{"id":"p14s3","text":" |
| `condition` | Regex triggers (legacy `ttsr_trigger` also accepted). |
| `astCondition` | ast-gr"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ep structural triggers, checked on tool arguments. |
| `question` | Natural-language question answer"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ed by a judge model. |
| `scope` | `text`, `thinking`, `tool`, `tool:<name>(<glob)`. |
| `agents` | "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"Agent-name globs; `main` and `sub` are reserved. |
| `interruptMode` | `never` \| `prose-only` \| `t"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ool-only` \| `always`. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"In the rule editor, a field with a fixed vocabulary — `interruptMode` today —
is a dropdown listing "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"exactly the accepted values, so the value cannot be
misspelled. That matters because an unrecognised"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" `interruptMode` is not
rejected: it falls back to the profile default, and the default is `always`."},{"id":"p15s4","text":"
The dropdown's first option means "inherit the profile default", and choosing it
**removes the line"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"** from the file. An empty value would parse as unrecognised
and land on the same default it was mea"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ile. An empty value would parse as unrecognised
and land on the same default it was meant to escape."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Write regexes with single-quoted YAML scalars. A double-quoted scalar treats
`\s`, `(` and `(`-famil"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"y sequences as YAML escapes, which makes js-yaml reject
the whole document. The plugin then falls ba"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ck to reading the block line by line
and recovers the value anyway, so the rule still loads and stil"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"l matches — but
the recovery cannot unescape a sequence YAML already refused, which is why the
singl"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"e-quoted form is the one to write."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Discovery"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Provider | Priority | Sources, most specific first |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `native` | 100 | `<cwd>/.omp/rules/*.md(c)`, `<userRulesDir>/rules/*.md(c)`, sticky `RULES.md` |

verbatim, MIT license"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"d, under the same names, so a rule file in either harness

none of them "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"blocks a write. The Go and Rust rules trigger on regular

OMP](#differences-from-omp)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## The Plugins page"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`dsh-rules` ships a browser half. The same two sections appear twice: on the

s"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ection draws unconditionally there."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The plugin's own configuration — `enabled`, `userRulesDir`, `pluginRoots`,
